content.title: Soon You’ll Be Able to Shop Walmart in ChatGPT. Here’s Why It Matters.
content.summary: Walmart  is forming a partnership with OpenAI to let shoppers buy its products directly within ChatGPT, the artificial-intelligence chatbot.  For years, shoppers have used a search bar and browsed a long list of items, Walmart Chief Executive  Doug McMillon  said Tuesday.  Within the next few months, U.S.-based ChatGPT users will be able to buy Walmart products instantly and directly in ChatGPT.

content.title: Walmart, IBD Stock Of The Day, Runs Past Buy Point On OpenAI Shopping Partnership
content.summary: Walmart stock gained on a partnership with OpenAI to allow shoppers to purchase goods directly through ChatGPT.

content.title: Walmart Teams With OpenAI for ChatGPT Purchases. The Retailer Is ‘Ahead of the Curve.’
content.summary: Now  Walmart  shoppers can buy items directly from chatbots, too.  Walmart said Tuesday that it’s teaming up with OpenAI to allow customers to purchase its products through ChatGPT using Instant Checkout.  The world’s biggest retailer has already incorporated plenty of cutting-edge technology in its business, including artificial intelligence tied to product discovery and recommendations.

content.title: Walmart partners with OpenAI for ChatGPT shopping feature
content.summary: Walmart has announced AI tools, including generative AI-powered 'Sparky,' which is available on its app to assist customers with product suggestions or summarizing product reviews, among other options.  The company's growing investment in AI is also aimed at closing the gap with online behemoth Amazon, which had a head start with its chatbot, Rufus, a Gen AI-powered shopping assistant that answers various shopping queries.  Walmart's tie-up with the ChatGPT-maker follows a similar partnership OpenAI announced last month with Etsy and Shopify.
